execution.isolation: For each case, expose only the named skill and that case's fixture. Do not expose this manifest or sibling cases.
execution.context: Run the case manually in a fresh session and record the assistant response before any implementation authorization.
execution.evaluation: Compare the response with required and forbidden criteria after the turn finishes; do not evaluate generic coding etiquette.

cases.prompt: Use $grilling to help decide whether to adopt the proposed repository change in SCENARIO.md. The scenario intentionally does not establish a priority between the two viable options. Do not implement anything yet.

required.criterion: Ask one focused question that resolves the first genuine tradeoff before proceeding.
Do not recommend an option when the scenario supplies no established priority.

forbidden: Modify repository files before explicit implementation authorization
Ask multiple independent questions in one turn
Choose an option solely because it is labeled recommended
